item.title: Concerns highlighted over busy Virginia junction
item.description: A Cavan county councillor has called for an update on proposed works for the junction at Bailieboro road, Virginia. Resurfacing works are planned for later this year, but TP O'Reilly says further safety measures are needed. He noted that the lights on the Dublin side are set too far back, leading to confusion and tailbacks that block traffic exiting the Bailieboro road. item.title: A piece of Clones history hits the market
item.description: A piece of Clones history has hit the open market. This historic Church of Ireland schoolhouse served the local community of Clones for many years. The school closed 17 years ago and has stood empty ever since. The substantial renovation project which requires a complete refurbishment has a price tag of €150,000. item.title: Eir doesn’t give a dam about its customers says local councillor
item.description: Eir doesn’t give a dam for its customers or its infrastructure according to a local councillor. Cllr Stiofan Conaty brought a motion to Cavan County Council calling on the management of Eir to ensure proper maintenance of rural overhead networks were carried out. He says that they should be answerable to the state and to their customers. Cllr Conaty pointed out that on most rural roads there are wires hanging and poles broken from the damage that was caused almost 13 months ago from Storm Eowyn.
